violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut lettuce stored in a container on the prep table was 63ºF.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC moved the container to the refrigerator to cool it down and store it.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: chicken noodle soup, wonton soup and sliced cold cuts were being held more than 24 hours and were not being date-marked. Any ready to eat foods prepared on site and held more than 24 hours must be date-marked.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. The EHS educated the PIC on date marking requirements for ready to eat food foods held more than 24 hours.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: there was an unknown food product being thawed at room temperature under the counter when the inspection started. The food was moved during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. Discontinue thawing foods at room temperature. Use one of the thawing methods listed above. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device. This was a violation during the last inspection. During the last inspection, the manager stated they ordered a thermometer, but today there was no thermometer present.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. The manager stated they will order a new thermometer today. Correct within 10 days. A follow up is required for this. Provide proof that you have a working thermometer on site within 10 days.

violations.title: Food Packaged, Labeled per Law
violations.observation: Food packaged in the establishment is not labeled in accordance with Law. The establishment purchases, bulk pastries and baked goods (cookies, muffins, fruit pastries) from Restaurant Depot, Costco, etc., then packages them individually and offers them for customer self service. The establishment also packages salads for self service. None of the individual packages are labeled as required.
violations.corrective_action: Food packaged in a food establishment shall be labeled as specified in Law including 21 CFR 101 - Food labeling, and 9 CFR 317 Labeling, marking devices, and containers. Food packaged in a food establishment for customer self service shall include labels that contain the following information: 1. the common name of the food, 2. the list of major ingredients including artificial colors or preservatives, 3. the total net weight or quantity of the food, 4. the name and place of business of the food manufacturer, packer, or distributor, 5. the name of the food source for each major food allergen contained in the food,6. nutrition labeling and, 7. for any salmonid fish containing canthaxanthin as a color additive, the labeling of the bulk fish container, including a list of ingredients, displayed on the retail container or by other written means. The EHS discussed this with the PIC who said she would come up with a plan to label the individual packages or remove the items from self service. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months. WOODBURN CAFE (Inspection Date: 05/21/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Discontinue storing wet wiping cloths on the counter and store them in a sanitizing solution between uses. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: the scoop for the cooked rice was stored in 73° standing water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The EHS discussed with the PIC that utensils may not be stored in standing water. The PIC cleaned and sanitized the container and the spoon during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked bulgogi beef in the reach in refrigerator was 47º and raw chicken was 45º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The CFM placed these foods in the freezer to cool them down to 41ºF.

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Cleaning chemicals were stored over foods in the storage closet.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. The CFM moved the cleaning chemicals to a lower shelf, below foods.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The CFM had a food thermometer, but it was not working.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. Suggest changing the batteries or obtaining a new thermometer. The manager ordered a new thermometer during the inspection.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: there was no thermometer in the small countertop TurboAir refrigerator used to stored cut fruit cups and prepared salads.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. The CFM placed a thermometer in the unit during the inspection. CDI.
